records.name: Verdant Works
records.description: Verdant Works, also known as Scotland's Jute Museum, is a former jute mill in the Blackness area of Dundee, Scotland. It was purchased in 1991 by the Dundee Heritage Trust.
records.hours: Apr–Oct: Mon–Sat 10am–5pm, Sun 11am–5pm; Nov–Mar: Wed–Sat 10am–4pm, Sun 11am–4pm

records.name: HM Frigate Unicorn
records.description: HMS Unicorn is a surviving sailing frigate of the successful Leda class, although the original design had been modified by the time that the Unicorn was built, to incorporate a circular stern and "small-timber" system of construction. Listed as part of the National Historic Fleet, Unicorn is now a museum ship in Dundee, Scotland, United Kingdom.

records.name: Dundee Museum of Transport
records.description: Volunteer-run transport museum covering classic cars, maritime engineering, local railways and Dundee-built vehicles.

records.name: Dundee Contemporary Arts
records.description: Dundee Contemporary Arts (DCA) is an art centre in Dundee, Scotland, with two contemporary art galleries, a two-screen cinema, a print studio, a learning and public engagement programme, a shop and a café bar. The current director of the DCA is Beth Bate.

records.name: Dundee Rep Theatre
records.description: Dundee Repertory Theatre, better known simply as the Dundee Rep, is a theatre and arts company in Dundee, Scotland.

records.name: Dundee Science Centre
records.description: Dundee Science Centre is a science centre located in Dundee, Scotland, and a part of the Scottish Science Centres Network. It is a registered charity under Scottish law. It is funded by the public and donations from local corporate sponsors.

records.name: Mills Observatory
records.description: Mills Observatory is the first purpose-built public astronomical observatory in the UK, located on the summit of Balgay Hill in Dundee, Scotland. Built in 1935, the observatory is classically styled in sandstone and has a distinctive 7 m dome, which houses a Victorian refracting telescope, a small planetarium, and display areas.
records.hours: Apr–Sep: Mon–Fri 11am–5pm, Sat–Sun 12:30pm–4pm; Oct–Mar: Mon–Fri 4pm–10pm, Sat–Sun 12:30pm–4pm; free admission

records.name: Dundee Law
records.description: Dundee Law is a hill in the centre of Dundee, Scotland, and is the highest point in the city. The Law is what remains of a volcanic sill, which is the result of volcanic activity around 400 million years ago. With a large war memorial at its summit, it is the most prominent feature on the local skyline.
records.hours: Open 24 hours (summit accessible year-round, road closed winter)

records.name: Dudhope Castle
records.description: Dudhope Castle is an extended late medieval tower house located on the southern face of Dundee Law in Dundee, Scotland.

records.name: Caird Hall

records.name: Dundee Parish Church (St Mary's)
records.description: Historic city-centre church beside the Old Steeple, long associated with Dundee's burgh history and the medieval parish of St Mary.

records.name: Baxter Park
records.description: Victorian public park designed with terraces, ornamental features and wide lawns, gifted to the city by the Baxter family.

records.name: Riverside Nature Park
records.description: Waterside park on the Tay with ponds, wildflower areas, birdlife and views back across the estuary and city skyline.

records.name: Caird Park
records.description: Large north Dundee parkland with open views, mature trees and sports facilities, reflecting the city's tradition of generous public green space.

records.name: D'Arcy Thompson Zoology Museum
records.description: Compact university museum named for the pioneering biologist D'Arcy Wentworth Thompson, with zoological specimens and scientific heritage displays.

records.name: Dundee International Submarine Memorial
records.description: Waterfront memorial commemorating international submariners and Dundee's long maritime and naval connections.

records.name: Dudhope Park
records.description: Hillside urban park around Dudhope Castle with mature trees, open lawns and good elevated views over western Dundee.

records.name: Wishart Arch
records.description: Medieval gateway and remnant of old Dundee associated with reformer George Wishart, tucked into the surviving lanes of the historic centre.

records.name: Minnie the Minx Statue
records.description: Public sculpture celebrating Dundee's long association with Beano and D.C. Thomson comic heritage.
